title: ROSÉ of BLACKPINK’s New Puma Ballet Sneakers Won’t Stay in Stock for Long: Here’s How to Get Them
summary: The K-pop idol continues the ballet sneaker trend as the face of Puma’s newest Speedcat Ballet sneakers.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

The ballet sneaker trend has a new celebrity-approved addition. BLACKPINK ’s ROSÉ is joining forces with Puma for the Speedcat Etoile , a new ballet-inspired take on the brand’s iconic racing sneaker that is available to shop now.

The latest Puma release features satin-inspired finishes, soft suede overlays and ribbon laces that can be tied into bows, giving the sporty silhouette a delicate balletcore update . Available in pastel pink, neutral beige and classic black, the new drop combines the comfort of a sneaker with the feminine aesthetic of a ballet flat.

The K-pop star’s latest Puma sneaker arrives in three must-have shades.

Puma’s newest Speedcat transforms a racing-inspired favorite into a balletcore essential. The Etoile sneakers feature a delicate design with ribbon laces, soft suede overlays and satin-inspired accents, paired with comfort-focused details such as a flat heel, regular width and mesh lining. Finished with signature Puma branding, the sneakers are available in three versatile shades.

ROSÉ’s influence continues to extend from music to fashion. The BLACKPINK member, who is one of the biggest names in global pop, made Billboard history with “APT.” featuring Bruno Mars; the track spent 12 weeks atop the Billboard Global 200 and peaked at No. 3 on the Billboard Hot 100 in 2025.

Now, the K-pop idol is bringing her signature style to Puma’s newest sneaker launch. The Speedcat Etoile campaign highlights ROSÉ’s personal aesthetic through nostalgic visuals inspired by childhood memories and keepsakes.

The release arrives as ballet sneakers remain one of the biggest footwear trends, and ROSÉ’s previous Puma collaboration helped fuel demand for the style. With fans and fashion shoppers already watching the new drop, the Speedcat Etoile could become another sought-after sneaker.

The Puma Speedcat Etoile is available now at Puma and select retailers.
